title: Genlock voice engine on the Mac: pinned Kokoro files and a per-project voice

requirements.text: genlock voice prints this project's voice, and running it twice, or after a Genlock update, prints the same voice
requirements.check: genlock voice twice in this repo -> same output

requirements.text: genlock voice set NAME or --blend a:0.6,b:0.4 records a project's voice in .genlock, and it is used from then on
requirements.check: genlock voice set bf_emma; genlock voice -> bf_emma

requirements.text: The model and voice table are checked by sha256 before use, and a mismatch refuses to speak rather than speaking in another voice
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs case with a tampered voices file -> refusal
manual: listen to genlock voice sample 'Voice 10 of 12'

requirements.text: genlock voice sample writes a wav of the project's voice
requirements.check: genlock voice sample -> wav file exists and plays

text: Roster for new projects drops bm_fable and af_nicole; Nicole only when a project sets her
user_said: i dont like fable. nicole is a bit dramatic. i feel like shes telling a story, so using that one shoudl be VERy specific to the content/project

evidence: genlock voice twice in this repo -> 'af_sarah (assigned just now)' then 'af_sarah (assigned 2026-11-12)'; tests/voices.mjs: recorded voice wins even off-roster
tests/voices.mjs: voice set af_nicole -> af_nicole; set bf_emma:3,af_heart:2 -> bf_emma:0.6,af_heart:0.4; unknown voice refused and leaves voice unchanged
tests/voices.mjs: fake install with non-pinned files -> exit 1 'do not match the pinned ones, so nothing was spoken ... voices.bin has sha256'; espeak-ng-data folder pinned too

speakable('Voice 10 of 12') -> 'Voice ten of twelve' (test); real sample of 'Voice 10 of 12 ...' via sherpa 1.13.8 printed no 'OOV word skipped' lines (2.0.1 had skipped '10'). TJ has not listened yet.
genlock voice sample -> ~/Desktop/genlock-voice-samples/this-project.wav, 6.2s of af_sarah, made in 6.3s

answers.observed: 20/20 tests in tests/voices.mjs; real wavs written by the CLI
answers.cause: OOV skipping measured on 2.0.1 (warnings) and absent on 1.13.8 (5.6s vs 3.6s for the same text)
answers.absence: tests never load the real engine: synthesis only proved by manual runs on this Mac
answers.assumption: first commit is a stable project identity; a repo with no commits falls back to folder name and would get another voice once it has commits, unless already recorded (it is recorded on first use)
answers.falsify: a clone with a different first commit; TJ hearing a skipped word

text: Audio is made on the Mac by one speaker process and sent to the phone, not synthesized on the phone: the phone only gets replies through the Mac's bridge anyway, so this loses nothing offline, and one engine guarantees one voice. Phone keeps its built-in TTS only as the fallback when no audio arrives.
user_said: is there no powerful open source one we can use irrelevant of the phone / mac? I want to have a GENLOCK voice that we can guarantee stays the same
